title: One Tiny Word (15s micro-cut)
voice_notes: Remix variant — reuses lesson-03-es audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: One tiny Spanish word builds a whole pile of sentences. Here it is.
That little word means is. Keep the S sound clean.
How would you say: it is normal?
How would you say: it is legal?

caption: One tiny Spanish word builds sentences: es normal, es legal. That's it, that's the grammar.
